name: Finding Miranda
source: You play a widower/divorced (your choice) man who is not interested in serious relationships. The only person who might make you change your mind is Miranda, your genius and mysterious co-worker who seem to have a solution to every problem, except for her own "secret problem". Will you be able to her and her friends against the mischievous Mortland and his diabolic plans?
translation: 你扮演一个鳏夫/离婚（你的选择）的男人，对认真的关系不感兴趣。唯一可能让你改变主意的人是米兰达，你的天才和神秘同事，她似乎对所有问题都有解决方案，除了她自己的“秘密问题”。你能帮助她和她的朋友们对抗顽皮的莫特兰和他的邪恶计划吗？
